name: aa_vendor_restock
title: Merchant box restock rule (three tests)
start: Go INSIDE the Goodsprings gas station (test save).

steps.script:
float fM
ref rF
Begin Function { }
let fM := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF := BuildRef fM 1452480
rF.RemoveAllItems
SetFunctionValue 1
End

ref rF
ref rC
float fV
Begin Function { }
let fM := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF := BuildRef fM 1452480
let rC := BuildRef fM 15
let fV := rF.GetItemCount rC
SetFunctionValue fV
End
steps.label: A0 box emptied
